name: gap_fill_full_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: Overnight gaps in Indian large-cap stocks fill completely (price returns to prior close) roughly 65-70% of the time within the session, driven by the behavioral tendency of institutional traders to fade overnight sentiment extremes and re-establish positions at prior day's equilibrium levels. Gaps of 0.3-1.0% are the sweet spot: large enough to be meaningful but small enough that they reflect sentiment shifts rather than genuine news. The inefficiency persists because retail traders chase gap direction (FOMO), providing liquidity to the counter-gap fade. The edge exists in the asymmetry between retail directional flow and institutional mean-reversion flow.
stock_filter: daily avg volume > ₹200cr; market cap > ₹50000cr; today's gap between 0.3% and 1.0%
indicators: vwap_dev = (close - vwap) / vwap * 10000  # bps from VWAP

conditions: gap_pct < -0.3 AND gap_pct > -1.0 (gap down, moderate size)
long.confirmation: price crosses above VWAP for the first time after gap down

conditions: gap_pct > 0.3 AND gap_pct < 1.0 (gap up, moderate size)
short.confirmation: price crosses below VWAP for the first time after gap up

entry.entry_price: market order at VWAP cross confirmation

exit.stop_loss: gap extends by 50% from open (e.g., 0.5% gap down extends to 0.75% below prev close) OR 0.5 * ATR_14
exit.trailing_stop: once 50% of gap filled, trail stop at 25% gap fill level
exit.time_stop: exit if held > 180 mins (gap should fill within 3 hours or likely won't)
exit.signal_exit: if NIFTY 50 moves > 1% in gap direction (confirming gap is structural), exit

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 20; high VIX gaps are more likely structural (news-driven)
filters.time_filter: enter only between 09:20-10:30 IST; if no entry by 10:30, skip today
filters.trend_filter: NIFTY 50 gap direction same as stock gap (sector-wide gap, not stock-specific news)
filters.event_filter: skip if stock has earnings, dividends, or corporate action today; skip if gap caused by identifiable news (analyst upgrade/downgrade, regulatory action)
other_filters: skip if stock gapped > 1% (too large, likely news-driven, lower fill probability)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — gap fill is a structural behavioral pattern that has persisted across decades and markets

weaknesses: Cannot reliably distinguish between sentiment-driven gaps (which fill) and news-driven gaps (which continue); the event_filter helps but is imperfect
Full gap fill requires patience — many gaps fill 70-80% and then reverse, hitting trailing stop before reaching the 100% target
On high-VIX days or macro event days, multiple stocks gap simultaneously in the same direction, creating correlated risk across the 2 allowed positions
prior_art: Caginalp & Laurent (1998) gap analysis; Cooper et al. (2004) gap returns. Indian market gap fill rates documented by various domestic trading educators with 60-70% fill rates for moderate gaps.
notes: Edge math: 0.65 * 55bps - 0.35 * 40bps = 35.75 - 14 = 21.75bps gross. Costs ~9bps RT. Net ~12.75bps/trade * avg 2 trades = ~25.5bps daily. Strong edge but requires disciplined stock selection (gap size filter is critical). The VWAP cross confirmation delays entry but dramatically improves win rate vs entering at open.
